pages.text: Fizz is sad. He sits in the rain and looks up at the hill.
pages.picture: sad baby dragon in the rain looking at a hill

pages.text: Fizz points up at the top of Dragon Hill.
pages.picture: dragon pointing at a tall hill

pages.text: On the top of the hill is a big dragon. She is fast asleep.
pages.picture: a huge dragon asleep on a hilltop

pages.text: "Then we will go to her," said Yara. "We will go up Dragon Hill."
Yara gets her backpack and her torch. Fizz flaps his wings. The quest starts!
pages.picture: girl with backpack and torch, dragon flapping
